sections.title: 项目文件夹浏览与导出 / project file browser & export
sections.unknown_reason: M13-06 is not implemented in the R-007 L-08 package: it requires K11 AccessPolicy (L-09 acl.py) to decide what may be exported. No file list and no export button are shown, because showing either without the ACL would misrepresent the export surface.
